spots.name: Bjork's Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 30 m (98 ft) tall.

spots.name: Crab Orchard Wildlife Viewing Area
